objects.description: Core client-side context/manager for i2pd. Owns address book, local destinations, TCP/UDP tunnels and proxies, and service bridges (SAM/BOB/I2CP). IRC-specific tunnel connection that can prepend WEBIRC authentication and annotate traffic with sender identity when bridging an I2P stream to a TCP IRC server.

HTTP-specialized server tunnel that injects HTTP-specific headers or behavior when bridging I2P streams to a TCP HTTP server. Overrides connection creation to return HTTP-aware connections.
IRC-specialized server tunnel that creates IRC-aware tunnel connections and optionally uses a WEBIRC password when forwarding to a TCP IRC server.

Enumeration of I2CP message delivery status codes used to report send results back to a client/session.
Enumeration of I2CP session lifecycle/status notifications sent to clients.

import os
import random
import struct
from typing import List

# Target expects generic strings used for:
# - argv/appName (program-like tokens)
# - tunnel/proxy names
# - outproxy URL
# - possibly host-like strings
# We generate a single bytes buffer that, when consumed by FUZZ_PARAM_STR/FILENAME,
# yields multiple interesting strings separated by NULs. The harness will pull
# them sequentially. Keep under 4096 bytes.

WORD_LIST = [
    # program/app names
    "i2pd", "router", "daemon", "svc", "tool",
    # tunnel/proxy names
    "srv", "http-proxy", "master", "sess", "bridge",
    # hostnames / b32-like tokens (not validated strictly but shaped)
    "example.i2p", "abcd1234efghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz.b32.i2p", "localhost",
    # flags/params-looking
    "--log=info", "--daemon", "--conf=router.conf",
    # outproxy URL forms
    "http://outproxy.i2p", "socks5://127.0.0.1:9050", "https://proxy.local/",
    # misc
    "A", "B", "C"
]

# Some interesting Unicode and control edge cases (generic strings allow any bytes)
UNICODE_SNIPPETS = [
    "πρόβα", "测试", "😀", "таблица", "مرحبا", "ñandú"
]

CONTROL_SNIPPETS = [
    b"\r\n", b"\n", b"\t", b"\x00", b"\x01\x02"
]

SCHEME_PARTS = ["http", "https", "socks4", "socks5"]
DOMAINS = ["i2p", "local", "onion", "invalid", "example.com"]
PATHS = ["/", "/index.html", "/status", "/a/b?x=1&y=2"]


def rand_token(r: random.Random) -> str:
    choice = r.randint(0, 4)
    if choice == 0:
        return r.choice(WORD_LIST)
    elif choice == 1:
        # random-looking base32-ish token
        alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz234567"
        ln = r.randint(5, 52)
        return "".join(r.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(ln)) + ".b32.i2p"
    elif choice == 2:
        # URL-ish
        scheme = r.choice(SCHEME_PARTS)
        host = r.choice(["outproxy", "proxy", "gw", "node"]) + "." + r.choice(DOMAINS)
        if r.random() < 0.5:
            host = host + ":" + str(r.randint(1, 65535))
        path = r.choice(PATHS)
        return f"{scheme}://{host}{path}"
    elif choice == 3:
        return r.choice(UNICODE_SNIPPETS)
    else:
        # random ascii token
        ln = r.randint(1, 32)
        return "".join(chr(r.randint(33, 126)) for _ in range(ln))


def build_strings(r: random.Random, count: int) -> List[bytes]:
    out: List[bytes] = []
    for _ in range(count):
        s = rand_token(r)
        b = s.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        # Occasionally inject controls inside
        if r.random() < 0.3 and CONTROL_SNIPPETS:
            frag = r.choice(CONTROL_SNIPPETS)
            pos = r.randint(0, len(b))
            b = b[:pos] + frag + b[pos:]
        out.append(b)
    return out


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    # Decide how many strings to emit. FUZZ stubs may request many FUZZ_PARAM_STR.
    # Provide a reasonable pool (8-32 tokens).
    n = r.randint(12, 28)
    strs = build_strings(r, n)

    # Ensure presence of some specific useful tokens likely used by stubs
    must_haves = [
        b"srv", b"http-proxy", b"master", b"sess", b"fuzzapp", b"127.0.0.1", b"::1",
        b"example.i2p", b"http://outproxy.i2p/", b"--log=info"
    ]
    for mh in must_haves:
        strs.append(mh)

    # Compose as NUL-separated fields so each FUZZ_PARAM_STR gets different data
    # Also include some length-prefixed segments as an alternative pattern separated by NUL.
    chunks: List[bytes] = []
    for b in strs:
        # Clip to keep total under limit later
        if len(b) > 256:
            b = b[:256]
        chunks.append(b)
    payload = b"\x00".join(chunks)

    # Add a small header with a magic and count to diversify initial bytes; still valid generic string set
    header = b"GGSTR\x00" + struct.pack("<H", len(chunks)) + b"\x00"
    final = header + payload

    if len(final) > 4096:
        final = final[:4096]
    return final
